messages:
maya: Quick idea: 'Topology contracts' — unify routing, region affinity, and isolation tiers so customers can pick clear SLAs. Goal: make Dedicated/Private migrations predictable.
alex: +1. Need clear tiers and launch gates. Customers will ask about cost impact and migration time.
sam: Proposal for tiers: Flexible (best-effort), Bounded (preferred region with failover), Pinned (region-only). Each maps to routing rules, eviction thresholds, and SLA.
nina: Sales ask: two prospects want per-tenant pinning and worst-case latency guarantees within 3 months. We should scope an alpha for Dedicated only.
alex: Runtime note: Pinned leads to capacity fragmentation. Add simulation to estimate cost multiplier.
sam: I'll draft a DSL sketch and precedence rules (what happens when capacity missing). Recommend degrade-to-Bounded with explicit consent.
maya: Draft launch criteria: policy DSL v1, sim report for common tenant mixes, failover playbook, one canary Dedicated customer.
alex: SRE asks: telemetry flag per request (isolation_mode), and alerts: sustained region overload, eviction_rate > 0.5%/min.
nina: I'll prepare the sales one-pager and migration checklist (manifest examples, SLA table, cost estimate).
maya: Owners: sam = spec, alex = sim + runtime, nina = sales docs, sam+alex = runbooks. Target: alpha in Q3.
deploy-bot: job queued: sim-runner-2026-02 (id 4321) :white_check_mark:
maya: Action items & deadlines sent in calendar invite. Ping for blockers. :thumbsup:
